title: RETRACTION: Ameliorative Effect of N‐acetyl Cysteine on Alpha‐Cypermethrin‐Induced Pulmonary Toxicity in Male Rats
content:
Retraction: M. H. Arafa, D. AE Mohamed, and H. H. Atteia, " Ameliorative Effect of N-acetyl Cysteine on Alpha-Cypermethrin-Induced Pulmonary Toxicity in Male Rats," Environmental Toxicology 30, no. 1 (2015): 26–43. https://doi.org/10.1002/tox.21891.

The above article, published online on 31 July 2013 in Wiley Online Library (wileyonlinelibrary.com), has been retracted by agreement between the journal Editor-in-Chief, April Rodd; and Wiley Periodicals LLC. As reported on PubPeer [1], the beta-actin controls for Figures 3A, 3B, and 3C had been reused, but different molecular weight ladder markers than the sample had been used in each case. An investigation by the publisher confirmed this, but also found evidence that the ladders for each of the bands in Figure 3 had been spliced into the respective image. Additionally, the investigation found that the HO-1 band in Figure 3A had been duplicated from another article by different authors [Chen et al. 2009 (https://doi.org/10.1186/1465-9921-10-55)] and that the beta-actin bands in Figures 3A, 3B, and 3C had been reproduced in another article by different authors [Mohamed et al. 2014 (https://doi.org/10.1186/1758-5996-6-88)]. While that data appears to have been reused by a different author group, that band presented in the other article also includes additional data, which creates doubt about the origin of the experiments reported in this article.

The authors responded to an inquiry by the publisher but were unable to provide original, unmodified data or images for the experiments reported. They were also unable to provide a sufficient explanation for the concerns of image duplication. The retraction has been agreed to because evidence of image duplication and manipulation fundamentally compromises the editor's confidence in the reported conclusions. The authors disagree with the retraction.

References:

[1] Rhabdocaulon strictum., Comments on “Ameliorative effect of N-acetyl cysteine on alpha-cypermethrin-induced pulmonary toxicity in male rats,” PubPeer, October 2025. https://pubpeer.com/publications/93C630D7F5171ED7A610B7F9856DCD.
